name: Sulzer S500
description: The Sulzer S500 is a rugged projectile weaving machine built for heavy-duty industrial fabric production. Renowned for its reliability and versatility, it efficiently handles a wide range of yarn types and fabric widths, making it a trusted choice for mills producing technical textiles, denim, and other heavy fabrics. Its robust projectile insertion system ensures consistent quality even under continuous, high-volume operation.
features: Handles wide range of yarn types
Consistent fabric quality at high volumes
